property_summary: For any successful payable call to fallback with exactly 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime to block.timestamp + 1; the mutant sometimes stores a larger value (block.timestamp + 2) due to an extra increment, so asserting that pastBlockTime == block.timestamp + 1 after the call is a universal property the reference satisfies and the mutant violates for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert an additional increment of pastBlockTime (add 1 more second) after the original assignment, changing the final stored value.
